verses.restored: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

familiar.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

modern.text: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר

verses.restored: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

familiar.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

modern.text: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.

original.text: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

familiar.text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

modern.text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.

original.text: חֲגֽוֹר חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ

verses.restored: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

familiar.text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

modern.text: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

original.text: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨ צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל דְּבַר אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

familiar.text: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

modern.text: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.

original.text: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: Your throne, O God [or: your divine throne], is forever and ever; a scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

familiar.text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

notes.title: Royal/divine address
notes.body: The Hebrew can be read as directly addressing the king as elohim (“O God”) or as describing a throne grounded in God/divine authority. Hebrews 1:8 later cites the Greek form. The ambiguity should remain visible.

modern.text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

original.text: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

familiar.text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

modern.text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.

original.text: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל כֵּ֤ן מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

familiar.text: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

modern.text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.

original.text: מֹר וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כָּל בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ

verses.restored: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

familiar.text: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

modern.text: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.

original.text: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִֽ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר

verses.restored: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

familiar.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

modern.text: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,

original.text: שִׁמְעִי בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ

verses.restored: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

familiar.text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

modern.text: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.

original.text: וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי לֽוֹ

verses.restored: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

familiar.text: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

modern.text: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

original.text: וּבַֽת צֹ֨ר בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם

verses.restored: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

familiar.text: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

modern.text: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.

original.text: כָּל כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ

verses.restored: She shall be brought to the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought to thee.

familiar.text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

modern.text: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.

original.text: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ

verses.restored: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

familiar.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

modern.text: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

original.text: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

familiar.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

modern.text: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

original.text: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

familiar.text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

modern.text: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.

original.text: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹדֻ֗ךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Royal and gender hierarchy belongs to an ancient court poem; it cannot justify coercive marriage, patriarchy, or leader immunity.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
